preparation.note: Everything outside 'keep' (tests, test models, other language bindings, the Java Gradle wrapper and the telemetry-only java/src/main/android-telemetry) is deleted before the source scan; none of it is used by this build. 'remove' prunes inside kept directories, including the Windows patch.exe and msys DLLs that CMake uses only on Windows.

dependencies.note: Fetched in the fetch phase from the URLs pinned in cmake/deps.txt of source.commit, verified against these SHA-1s (the same ones deps.txt pins), and served to CMake through onnxruntime_CMAKE_DEPS_MIRROR_DIR so the build phase downloads nothing. The mirror lives outside the source tree (FPINK_ORT_DEPS_DIR, default ~/.cache/fpink/onnxruntime-deps). Telemetry-only dependencies (cpp_client_telemetry, curl, mbedtls) are not fetched.
dependencies.hostProtoc: Built from the 'protobuf' and 'abseil_cpp' archives for the build host, with the protobuf patches ONNX Runtime applies, instead of ONNX Runtime's default download of a prebuilt protoc binary.

build.cxxFlagsNote: Appended to CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS. ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 builds its own targets with COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR, and onnxruntime/core/mlas/lib/kleidiai/halfgemm_kleidiai.cpp defines Sve2p1HalfGemmKernelName but only uses it with test hooks or KleidiAI kernel logging, so builds without unit tests fail on -Wunused-const-variable. The flag keeps the warning but stops it failing the build; it does not change generated code. Recorded in PROVENANCE and verified by Gradle.
build.reproducibility: expectedSha256 pins the stripped libraries built by scripts/build-runtime.sh with NDK 28.2.13676358 and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set to the pinned ONNX Runtime commit time. Build paths are mapped away (-ffile-prefix-map), so F-Droid's buildserver-trixie image at /home/vagrant/build/com.fpink.capture and other Linux x86_64 hosts produce the same bytes. -PortRuntimeBuiltFromSource fails on a mismatch unless -PallowUnpinnedOrtRuntime is set.
networkInputs: dependencies.archives (https, fetch phase only, SHA-1 verified)
